name: penrose-maze
title: penrose-maze
blurb: a first-person maze carved into a real Penrose tiling. every room renders as an ordinary square — the aperiodic, locally-5-fold geometry underneath is never let on screen, not even on the debug minimap, which draws your local grid rather than the true tiling so its walls and facing arrow always agree with what you see. @shibbi.me asked for it.
